title: Iran Security Chief Says Tehran Has Given Mediators Its Conditions for Resuming Talks With Washington
detail: September 19, 2026 — Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Expediency Discernment Council and a senior security official, said Iran has conveyed to Qatari and Pakistani mediators its conditions for re-engaging in negotiations to end the war with the United States: an end to fighting on all fronts, release of Iran's frozen assets, and a lifting of the US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. Rezaei said Tehran was awaiting a response from President Trump. The statement follows the Sep 1 exchange in which Trump rejected President Pezeshkian's SCO-summit offer to revive the June ceasefire, and precedes the direct Araghchi-Witkoff-Kushner contact during UN General Assembly week.

sources.name: The Times of Israel — Liveblog September 19, 2026

confidenceReason: Sourced to Rezaei's own remarks as reported in a single outlet's liveblog; no independent second-source confirmation of the specific three conditions was found in available sources.

media.caption: Iran's Expediency Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei says Tehran has set conditions for resuming talks with the US via Qatari and Pakistani mediators
